full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 71 S. 2010 May 31, 2010 SB MEMBER DOREE JANE P. PAGUNSAN Office of the Sangguniang Bayan Valderama, Antique Dear SB Pagunsan: This has reference to the indorsement of Regional Director Evelyn A. Trompeta of DILG-Region VI, referring to us your letter query pertaining to the designation of a Temporary Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan. Per your letter, the duly appointed Secretary to Sangguniang Bayan was on sick leave since 28 December 2009. In the meantime and in her absence, the Administrative Aide II with salary grade IV was to act as the temporary secretary to the sanggunian. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department have already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 44 s. 2006. In the said DILG opinion we opined that an appointive official, during his tenure as such, cannot be appointed or designated in any capacity to any other public office or position. However, in cases of exigency of the service, a mere designation or an imposition of additional duties to an officer of the municipality is allowed subject to such limitations provided under pertinent laws and rules. Attached herewith is a photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 44 s. of 2006 for your ready reference. Thank you very much. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATT .
